text: A tapering spire of March Crystal in the Crystal Fields, with a waystation at its foot.
At the foot of the spire is a small camp: a hearth, banners, a Loom totem, beds and a loom. Two Loom-stitchers of the Spindle tribe live there, an Elder and a Weaver.
It is the only kind of camp the Loom-stitchers keep, and it only appears in the Crystal Fields. A Lore Tablet hangs inside.
pages.title: The waystation

text: They welcome **March Crystal**, **Loom Thread** and compasses as offerings. Each one raises your [standing](standing) with the tribe.
At **Friend** standing they open Loom Thread trades, which is the steady supply you want once you have looted the Ancestor Halls near you.
Their full story is on the [Loom-stitchers](tribe_spindle) page.
pages.title: Trading with the Loom-stitchers

text: The Crystal Fields are terraced mesas, and it is easy to lose your bearings among the crystal. Bind a compass before you wander.
Shardbacks shove hard near the ledges. Keep your back away from the drops.
pages.title: Getting around
